This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?
 

We’re looking for ambitious, detail-oriented professionals to help shape the future of medicine. At our leading biotech company, you won’t just find a job you’ll begin a meaningful, long-term career in advanced biomanufacturing.
 

Your journey starts with comprehensive training, where you’ll learn the fundamentals of aseptic (germ-free) techniques and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), the key standards that guide our industry. You’ll quickly gain confidence with the tools, procedures, and mindset that define high-quality biotech production.
 

After onboarding, you’ll join our dynamic Operations team, working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies and sterile processes. Together with your colleagues, you’ll perform precise manual and aseptic production steps, always following clear protocols to guarantee patient safety and product quality.
 

What your day-to-day will look like:
 

 
• Contributing to aseptic and manual production processes
 
• Working in a cleanroom laboratory environment
 
• Performing production steps in controlled areas (grade A/B/C/D), such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products
 
• Managing equipment, including inspections and maintenance
 
• Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
 
• Supporting transitions between production zones
 
• Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time 

 
• You’re eager to apply your scientific background and contribute to something meaningful, making a real difference in the lives of patients.
 
• You’re energized by dynamic environments and excited to keep learning and growing within advanced biomanufacturing.
 
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences, and you’re ready to take the next step from the classroom to cutting-edge industry.
 
• You value structure and precision, and you feel comfortable working in a sterile (aseptic) setting, wearing the proper cleanroom gear.
 
• High-tech equipment and innovative processes spark your curiosity, you want to be part of what’s next.
 
• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
 
• You’re a real team player with a strong eye for detail, and you understand the importance of following procedures carefully.
 
• You’re flexible and open to working in shifts.
 
• You’re excited about a 4-days-on, 4-days-off schedule that supports both focus and work-life balance.

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.
 

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.
 

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.
 

Your role and responsibilities;
 
 
 
• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes. 
 
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards. 
 
• Perform production activities in controlled environments (Grade A/B/C/D), including spiking, media exchanges, cell culture activities and freezing of therapeutic products. 
 
• Execute thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials and equipment. 
 
• Support transitions between production zones, ensuring compliance and continuity. 
 
 

This role is suited for you if you:
 

 
• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
 
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
 
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.
 
• Communicate fluently in English.
 
• Live near Zwijnaarde and can commute independently to the site.

Fluves is a pioneer in fiber optic sensing, combining advanced DTS and DAS technology, real-time data processing and smart analytics to monitor and protect critical infrastructure.
 

Through its Marlinks product line, Fluves monitors more than 1,800 km of subsea power cables linking offshore wind farms and power grids. The DALI product line detects leaks and intrusions in water networks. Fluves Corrosion assesses the risk of corrosion under insulation in chemical plants.
 

Fluves is a growing international scale-up, active in critical infrastructure markets around the world.
 

Our products handle high-volume DAS/DTS signals. Doing that reliably depends on a IT stack with a set of backend (edge) services that ingest data, orchestrate workloads, expose APIs, and integrate outputs into our application. We are looking for a software engineer to build and evolve this stack, ensuring secure, scalable, and observable processing from field deployments through to client-facing applications.
 

What you will do
 

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated software engineer for the following responsibilities:
 
 

• Take an active role in the development of the edge-server platform, application backend and API integrations. 

• Challenge existing poor architectural patterns constructively and bring structure. Propose, showcase and implement architectural alternatives to improve the computational flow. 

• Actively and continuously improve and modernize existing components, focusing on incremental, high-impact enhancements. 

• Extend the existing monitoring and benchmarks and profile the current code to identify and improve bottle necks. 

• Collaborate closely with colleagues in the product development team to design, build, and continuously improve product features in the edge and application layer, and deliver new integrations with internal, third-party, and client platforms. 

• Document best practices and clarify trade-offs to shorten the time to deployment of new data product features. 

Who you are
 
 

• Holds a degree in computer science or computer engineering, or has equivalent experience. 

• At least 3 years of experience. 

• Professional Python developer with proven experience with backend development in Django, Django restframework, Postgres and Timescaledb. 

• Track record in parallel computing and multiprocessing and/or experience with message brokers, storage backends and task queues (e.g. RabbitMQ, Redis, Celery …). 

• Understanding the limitations of computer hardware (CPU and GPU and disk storage patterns). 

• Knowledge of low-level programming languages and/or GPU architecture. 

• Preferably feels comfortable with scientific Python libraries for array computing such as Numpy and Xarray. 

• Some notion of the frequency domain and Fourier transformation is appreciated. 

• Clear and open communicator striving for clarity with a documentation reflex. 

• Writes unit tests, keeps (sphinx) documentation up to date, knows git and is familiar with CI/CD pipelines. 

• Uses AI tools as a standard part of how you write, review, and reason about code, while remaining accountable for the outcome. 

• Down to earth, hands-on problem solver that likes to take a deep dive into computational challenges. 

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Proficiency in one additional language — Dutch, French, or German — is highly desirable, along with strong writing and presentation skills. 

• Current residence in Belgium.

For our client Kuehne + Nagel, a leading international logistics company, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen their team. Are you accurate and interested in working in an international environment? Then this opportunity is for you!

You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the right place.- You work with an electric pallet truck.- You strictly follow the safety and quality rules.
- Vaardigheden:You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.You can work in a cold environment of -22°C without any problemsYou enjoy active work.You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.- Attesten:Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.- Opleidingsvereisten:No diploma required.- Talenkennis:Good knowledge of English

jobs.description:
Our client is an established international financial services group headquartered in Brussels. Operating in a regulated and international environment, the organisation combines financial expertise with a strong focus on governance, risk management and internal control.To strengthen its Group Internal Audit department, we are currently looking for an experienced Group Internal Auditor.

Jobomschrijving

• Perform financial, operational and compliance audits across the Group
• Support the Group Chief Internal Auditor in defining and implementing the risk-based internal audit plan
• Independently manage complex audit assignments from scoping to final reporting
• Assess internal controls, governance and risk management frameworks, including IT/ICT-related risks
• Formulate clear and practical recommendations based on audit findings
• Present audit results to senior management and governance bodies
• Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and action plans
• Coordinate audit follow-ups and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Internal Audit function

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance or another relevant field
• At least 7 years of relevant audit experience, ideally acquired within an international environment and/or a Big Four firm
• Strong knowledge of internal audit methodologies, risk-based auditing and internal control frameworks
• Previous exposure to IT/ICT audits is required
• Experience within Banking, Insurance or Financial Services is considered a strong asset
• A CIA, CISA or equivalent professional certification is considered an advantage
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate findings into practical and business-oriented recommendations
• Capable of managing complex audit assignments autonomously from start to finish
• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to combine critical thinking with diplomacy and influence
• Proactive, structured and comfortable working independently within a compact audit team
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, combined with a good command of Dutch and/or French

Are you a hands-on and service-minded professional who enjoys creating a welcoming and well-organised workplace? In this varied role, you will ensure the smooth daily operation of a modern international office while acting as a key contact for employees, visitors and external service providers.
 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

 

Description

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.
 

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

Your Role? 
 
 

• Process and verify purchase invoices and expense reports with a high level of accuracy. 

• Prepare supplier payments and follow up on outstanding balances. 

• Process bank statements and monitor cash reporting. 

• Support the preparation of VAT and intra-community (IC) declarations. 

• Assist in the reconciliation of balance sheet accounts. 

• Contribute to month-end and year-end closing activities. 

• Support audit preparation and ensure compliance with internal and external requirements. 

• Ensure financial data is processed accurately, timely, and consistently. 

• Support Corporate Income Tax (CIT) preparation. 

• Contribute to ad hoc projects and process improvement initiatives.  

 
 

Your Profile: 
 
 

• You have initial experience in General accounting 

• Experience with SAP is required. 

• You have a solid understanding of accounting principles. 

• You are fluent in Dutch, French, and English. 

• You combine strong analytical skills with a hands-on mindset. 

• You are accurate, detail-oriented, and well organized.

• You think critically, challenge constructively, and propose solutions. 

• You are eager to learn and comfortable exploring new tools and systems independently.
